p.i: given by the Lord through Joseph Smith Jr., November 1831, at Hiram, Ohio.

chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 Hearken, O you people of my church, says the voice of him who dwells on high, and whose eyes are upon all men. Yea, truly I say, hearken you people from afar, and you that are upon the islands of the sea, listen together, VerseEnd Verse2 for truly the voice of the Lord is unto all men, and there is none to escape. And there is no eye that shall not see, neither ear that shall not hear, neither heart that shall not be penetrated. VerseEnd Verse3 And the rebellious shall be pierced with much sorrow, for their iniquities shall be spoken upon the housetops and their secret acts shall be revealed, VerseEnd Verse4 and the voice of warning shall be unto all people by the mouth of my disciples whom I have chosen in these last days. VerseEnd Verse5 They shall go forth and none shall stay them, for I, the Lord, have commanded them. VerseEnd

Verse6 Behold, this is my authority, and the authority of my servants, and my preface unto the book of my commandments which I have given them to publish unto you, O inhabitants of the earth. VerseEnd Verse7 Wherefore, fear and tremble, O you people, for what I, the Lord, have decreed in them shall be fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse8 And truly I say unto you that they who go forth, bearing these tidings unto the inhabitants of the earth, to them is power given to seal both on earth and in Heaven, the unbelieving and rebellious, VerseEnd Verse9 yea, truly, to seal them up unto the day when the wrath of God shall be poured out upon the wicked without measure, VerseEnd Verse10 unto the day when the Lord shall come to recompense unto every man according to his works, and measure to every man according to the measure which he has measured to his fellow man. VerseEnd

Verse11 Wherefore, the voice of the Lord is unto the end of the earth, that all that will hear may hear: VerseEnd Verse12 Prepare yourselves, prepare for that which is to come, for the Lord is near VerseEnd Verse13 and the anger of the Lord is kindled, and his sword is bathed in Heaven and it shall fall upon the inhabitants of the earth, VerseEnd Verse14 and the arm of the Lord shall be revealed. And the day comes that they who will not hear the voice of the Lord, neither his servants, neither give heed to the words of the prophets and apostles, shall be cut off from among the people, VerseEnd Verse15 for they have strayed from my ordinances and have broken my everlasting covenant. VerseEnd Verse16 They seek not the Lord to establish his righteousness, but every man walks in his own way and after the image of his own god, whose image is in the likeness of the world, and whose substance is that of an idol which waxes old and shall perish in Babylon, even Babylon the great which shall fall. VerseEnd

Verse17 Wherefore, I, the Lord, knowing the calamity which should come upon the inhabitants of the earth, called upon my servant Joseph and spoke unto him from Heaven, and gave him commandment, VerseEnd Verse18 and also gave commandments to others that they should proclaim these things unto the world. And all this that it might be fulfilled which was written by the prophets: VerseEnd Verse19 the weak things of the world should come forth and break down the mighty and strong ones, that man should not counsel his fellow man, neither trust in the arm of flesh, VerseEnd Verse20 but that every man might speak in the name of God, the Lord, even the Savior of the world, VerseEnd Verse21 that faith also might increase in the earth, VerseEnd Verse22 that my everlasting covenant might be established, VerseEnd Verse23 that the fullness of my gospel might be proclaimed by the weak and the simple unto the ends of the world and before kings and rulers. VerseEnd Verse24 Behold, I am God and have spoken it.

These commandments are of me, and were given unto my servants in their weakness, after the manner of their language, that they might come to understanding. VerseEnd Verse25 And inasmuch as they erred, it might be made known; VerseEnd Verse26 and inasmuch as they sought wisdom, it might be instructed; VerseEnd Verse27 and inasmuch as they sinned, they might be chastened that they might repent; VerseEnd Verse28 and inasmuch as they were humble, they might be made strong, and blessed from on high, and receive knowledge from time to time, VerseEnd Verse29 after they having received the record of the Nephites. Yea, even my servant Joseph might have power to translate through the mercy of God, by the power of God, the Book of Mormon. VerseEnd Verse30 And also, those to whom these commandments were given might have power to lay the foundation of this church, and to bring it forth out of obscurity and out of darkness, the only true and living church upon the face of the whole earth with which I, the Lord, am well pleased — speaking unto the church collectively and not individually. VerseEnd Verse31 For I, the Lord, cannot look upon sin with the least degree of allowance; VerseEnd Verse32 nevertheless, he that repents and does the commandments of the Lord shall be forgiven, VerseEnd Verse33 and he that repents not, from him shall be taken even the light which he has received. For my spirit shall not always strive with man, says the Lord of Hosts. VerseEnd

Verse34 And again, truly I say unto you, O inhabitants of the earth, for I, the Lord, am willing to make these things known unto all flesh, VerseEnd Verse35 for I am no respecter to persons and will that all men shall know that the day speedily comes; the hour is not yet, but is nearly at hand, when peace shall be taken from the earth and the Devil shall have power over his own dominion; VerseEnd Verse36 and also, the Lord shall have power over his saints, and shall reign in their midst, and shall come down in judgment upon Idumea, or the world. VerseEnd

Verse37 Search these commandments for they are true and faithful, and the prophecies and promises which are in them shall all be fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse38 What I, the Lord, have spoken, I have spoken, and I excuse not myself. And though the heaven and the earth pass away, my word shall not pass away, but shall all be fulfilled, whether by my own voice or by the voice of my servants it is the same. VerseEnd Verse39 For behold and lo, the Lord is God and the spirit bears record, and the record is true, and the truth abides for ever and ever. Amen. VerseEnd
